source: NOAA OSMC State of the Ocean, weekly Dipole Mode Index from OISST, base 1991-2020, not detrended. https://stateoftheocean.osmc.noaa.gov/sur/data/dmi.nc, retrieved 2026-10-16
definition: DMI = WTIO (50-70E, 10S-10N) minus SETIO (90-110E, 10S-0) SST anomaly, degC
iod_phase_rule: SON-mean DMI > +0.4 positive, < -0.4 negative [J; BoM's +/-0.4 convention, UNVERIFIED at source]. Because the series is not detrended, warming of the western pole biases recent years toward positive.

notes.2015: Sources disagree on whether 2015 was a positive-IOD year; the DMI peaked in Sep and decayed by Nov. Treat it as at most weak or short-lived (MODEL_SPEC section 2.2; Fanin & van der Werf 2017 describe 2015 IOD conditions as neutral).

verified: monthly means reproduce the MODEL_SPEC section 2.2 table for 1997, 2006, 2015, 2019 and 2023 exactly
